title: Noetherian spaces of dimension at most one have no cohomology above degree one
statement: Let X be a Noetherian topological space (every nonempty set of closed subsets of X has a minimal element for inclusion, equivalently every descending chain of closed subsets stabilizes), with topological Krull dimension at most 1 [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let F be an abelian sheaf on X. Then the sheaf cohomology group H^2(X,F) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero.
